feeds.title: Brooklyn Street Art
feeds.description: Brooklyn Street Art (BSA), founded in 2008 by Steven P. Harrington and Jaime Rojo, is a prominent platform dedicated to documenting and celebrating the dynamic world of street art and graffiti. Based in Brooklyn but with a global reach, BSA provides insightful commentary, analysis, and extensive photography, capturing the evolving landscape of public art from New York to São Paulo and beyond. Harrington serves as Editor-in-Chief, while Rojo is the Editor of Photography. The blog is committed to supporting the arts and fostering respect for creative expression and property.
